spec_match.rationale: Calls getPathSegmentAtLength(d) together with getPointAtLength(d) and matches the returned dictionary against getPathData() to name the leg.

interactive.rationale: A distance slider, a live leg highlight and five edge-input buttons.

edge_cases.rationale: Negative, NaN, past the end, empty d, and a zero-length moveto, each with the explainer's expected value next to the observed one.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus and the explainer section.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless: by default all three methods are undefined (each page shows its labelled unsupported state). With --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, getPathData/setPathData are live but getPathSegmentAtLength is still undefined. Both viewports, every control exercised, console/network clean, 0px overflow. The method is missing even with the flag in 153, so only the labelled 'API missing' state and the getPointAtLength van movement were observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the leg match on each leg change, and records each edge case's observed vs expected result in details.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled range with an output, the leg announced politely only on change, and a role=log for edge results.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Readout grid collapses to one column. 0px overflow.

openQuestions.title: Verify getPathSegmentAtLength on Chrome 160+
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153 ships getPathData/setPathData behind the flag but not getPathSegmentAtLength. Re-verify the route scrubber and the segment-at-length conformance assertion on a build that has it.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid of readouts collapsing to one column
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use grid with min-width:0 children and let tracks collapse on narrow containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Fact/readout grids are one column below 640px and min-width:0 on grid children. A measured 91px overflow from <pre> blocks in a 2-column grid was fixed with .cmp > div { min-width: 0 }.

summary: Route progress driven by getPathSegmentAtLength, with every documented edge input made as a real call.
